summary: order preview and order place (dry-run included) print a summary first: items, subtotal, discounts, tax, tip, total, card hold (from totalLinesTrackingEvent total_lines, cents as strings), card brand/last 4 and store when present, and the window booked by slots pick (kept per hashed checkout session id in the state dir for 7 days). not_in_response lists missing fields. order place fetches the invoice read-only only on --dry-run or with both consent flags, so a refusal stays offline. slots pick prints booked_window.
reason: order place --dry-run printed no totals and order preview buried the numbers in the raw invoice; the booked window was not shown after slots pick.
validated_outcome: Stub tests: the summary values come from a fake invoice; summary is the first key of order preview and order place --dry-run output; dry-run sends only the invoice GET and never FinalizeCheckout; a refused place sends nothing; a slots pick booked window shows in the same session's preview but not in another session's; the state file holds no raw session id. Not run live (needs an open checkout).
review_fixes: PR #2320 review: booked windows are stored one file per hashed session id, written via temp file + rename (no shared read-modify-write); a --token pick without a label clears the earlier entry; entries older than 7 days are ignored on load as well as pruned on save.
